raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China-origin exporters and re-exporters, this changes license requirements and classification for sporting and hunting firearms under ECCNs and USML Category I boundaries. Verify whether items fall under EAR99, ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504, or ITAR USML Category I, and confirm the new license exception eligibility. Screen all parties against the BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN. Align commercial invoices with 10-digit HTS codes and retain end-use/end-user statements. Note that Section 301 tariffs and FCC Part 15/18 requirements still apply to wireless-enabled accessories.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于中国原产出口商和再出口商而言，这改变了运动及狩猎枪支在ECCN和美国军品清单（USML）第一类边界下的许可要求和分类。需核实物品属于EAR99、ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504还是ITAR USML第一类，并确认新的许可例外适用性。对所有交易方进行BIS实体清单、被拒绝人员名单及OFAC SDN筛查。商业发票需与10位HTS编码对齐，并保留最终用途/最终用户声明。注意：第301节关税及FCC Part 15/18要求仍适用于带无线的配件。

checklist.desc: Determine whether firearms, ammunition, and parts fall under EAR99, ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504, or ITAR USML Category I; document classification rationale and license exception eligibility after the rule rescission.
For wireless-enabled accessories (optics, tracking devices), confirm intentional radiator approvals, modular FCC IDs, and supplier declarations before US entry.
Map each line to the 10-digit HTS code, check Section 301 lists and additional duty exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up on the commercial invoice.
Run restricted party screening against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN; retain end-user and end-use statements for controlled firearms and parts.

checklist.task: RoHS / REACH and WEEE check for accessories
checklist.desc: For electronic accessories, verify RoHS and REACH compliance and WEEE producer responsibility registration where EU-bound or transshipped.

checklist.task: Export license application or exception record
checklist.desc: If a license is required, file with BIS SNAP-R and keep the license exception record; if no license is required, retain a written determination for audit.
